name: Harborview Market
notes: Menu transcribed item by item from Harborview's January 2025 price-updated menu images posted on its website; prices and descriptions as printed. Address from website. Phone from website. Hours from the menu. Entire menu served all day. Also offers classic deli salads and meats (tuna salad, chicken salad, oven-roasted roast beef, egg salad, Boar's Head turkey, ham, salami, pepperoni, mortadella); no prices listed for these.
taglineEn: American cafe and market in Bridgeport
taglineEs: Cafetería y mercado americano en Bridgeport
address: 218 Harborview Avenue, Bridgeport, CT, 06605, United States
